name: Gakkou Nanafushigi 5
source: There is a prefectural high school where there is a true story of two female students who disappeared, which became a ghost story of the school. Now a graduate of the school who became a TV director attempts to film a special to see if the ghosts can be captured on camera.
translation: 有一所县立高中，发生了两名女学生失踪的真实故事，成为学校的鬼故事。现在，一名成为电视导演的学校毕业生试图拍摄一部特别节目，看看是否可以用摄像机捕捉到鬼魂。
